# entrepot_gitlab_trust_policy (Resource)

A GitLab trust policy lets GitLab CI/CD jobs authenticate with their `id_token` (no stored secrets). A job is matched to the policy when its token was issued by the named GitLab instance and every condition matches; bind roles to the policy with `entrepot_role_binding` (`subject_type = "gitlab_policy"`). Deleting a policy also deletes the role bindings that reference it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Trust id_tokens from protected branches of projects under platform/ on the
# GitLab instance configured as "gitlab" in the server's auth.gitlab list.
resource "entrepot_gitlab_trust_policy" "platform" {
  name        = "platform-protected"
  description = "Protected pipelines of the platform group"
  gitlab      = "gitlab"
  conditions = {
    project_path  = "platform/**"
    ref_protected = "true"
  }
}

# In .gitlab-ci.yml:
#   id_tokens:
#     ENTREPOT_TOKEN:
#       aud: https://entrepot.example.com
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `conditions` (Map of String) `id_token` claim → glob pattern; all must match. Common claims: `project_path`, `namespace_path`, `ref`, `ref_type`, `ref_protected`, `environment`, `pipeline_source`. `*` matches within a path segment, `**` across segments and `a|b` either alternative, e.g. `{ project_path = "platform/**", ref_protected = "true" }`.
- `gitlab` (String) Name of a trusted GitLab instance from the server's `auth.gitlab` configuration (listed in `GET /api/v1/system/info` as `gitlabInstances`).
- `name` (String) Policy name, used as the role binding subject. Changing it forces a new policy.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `name`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# GitLab trust policies are imported by name.
terraform import entrepot_gitlab_trust_policy.platform platform-protected
```
